title: Situational Awareness’s Mystery Investment Was to Source Foundry

title: Union Workers Strike at BHP’s Port Hedland Iron Ore Export Hub

title: Canada’s PSP Is Said to Mull $1.5 Billion Sale of Roads in India

title: New Zealand Slaps New Sanctions Against Russia After US Move

title: US Partly Resumes Operations in Mexico’s Avocado State Michoacan

title: SEC Drops Insider-Trading Suit Against Executive Trump Pardoned

title: CFTC Warns Prediction Markets on American-Style Casino Odds

title: Yen Jumps on US Data as Traders Watch for Intervention Clues
summary: The yen surged against a weaker dollar after an unexpectedly soft US payrolls report on Friday, with traders on alert for any sign authorities were preparing to intervene in the Japanese currency again.

title: Optimizing Life and Finances in Your Twenties | Masters in Business with Jack Raines
summary: Barry sits down with Jack Raines author of "Younge Money". Jack dives into his unlikely journey into finance and venture capital. He discusses how his travels impacted the way he sees money and purpose in your twenties. He also reviews how to incorporate passion into your career and the impact it will have in your long-term finances. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dollar Ends Week at Lowest Since May as Rate-Hike Bets Fade

title: How the PGA Is Growing the Game and Winnings for Players
summary: Brian Rolapp, CEO of PGA Tour, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the changing landscape of sports media coverage, the rising costs of streaming bills for consumers, and the evolution of the PGA Tour after the rise and fall of LIV Golf. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Once Upon a Farm CEO on Outlook Boost, Consumer Demand
summary: John Foraker, Co-Founder and CEO of Once Upon a Farm, discussed the company's strong 42% sales growth in the recent quarter and expressed confidence in sustaining this momentum due to resilient consumer demand across baby and kid food categories. The company has raised its guidance for the full year and anticipates continued growth. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Credit Card Balances at Pace with Inflation: Whitney

title: S&P 500 Has Best Week Since April After Jobs Data: Markets Wrap

title: SpaceX Nears IPO Price Again After Staging $327 Billion Rally
